message:
Command `cd /workspace && rm -rf pocwork && mkdir pocwork && cd pocwork && cat > san.cnf <<'EOF'
[req]
distinguished_name=req_dn
x509_extensions=v3_req
prompt=no
[req_dn]
CN=localhost
[v3_req]
subjectAltName=@alt_names
basicConstraints=CA:false
[alt_names]
DNS.1=first.example
otherName.1=1.3.6.1.5.5.7.8.4;SEQ:hw_module_name
DNS.2=third.example
[hw_module_name]
hwtype=OID:1.3.6.1.4.1.17.3
hwserial=OCT:123456
EOF
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:1024 -nodes -keyout key.pem -out cert.pem -outform PEM -days 1 -config san.cnf -sha256 >/tmp/ossl.log 2>&1 && openssl x509 -in cert.pem -outform DER -out cert.der && wc -c cert.der && openssl asn1parse -inform DER -in cert.der -i | grep -A20 -B5 'X509v3 Subject Alternative Name'` executed with exit code 0.

content:
cd /workspace && rm -rf pocwork && mkdir pocwork && cd pocwork && cat > san.cnf <<'EOF'
[req]
distinguished_name=req_dn
x509_extensions=v3_req
prompt=no
[req_dn]
CN=localhost
[v3_req]
subjectAltName=@alt_names
basicConstraints=CA:false
[alt_names]
DNS.1=first.example
otherName.1=1.3.6.1.5.5.7.8.4;SEQ:hw_module_name
DNS.2=third.example
[hw_module_name]
hwtype=OID:1.3.6.1.4.1.17.3
hwserial=OCT:123456
EOF



openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:1024 -nodes -keyout key.pem -out cert.pem -outform PEM -days 1 -config san.cnf -sha256 >/tmp/ossl.log 2>&1 && openssl x509 -in cert.pem -outform DER -out cert.der && wc -c cert.der && openssl asn1parse -inform DER -in cert.der -i | grep -A20 -B5 'X509v3 Subject Alternative Name'
